purpose: Machine-readable cross-reference of every immediate directory under twins/ to its catalogue records, kind, status, achieved fidelity, independent evidence, blockers, owner artefact and open issues. It restates what each directory and record already says; it promotes no fidelity and qualifies no part. scripts/validate_twins_index.py checks it against the tree, the catalogue and the table in twins/README.md.

kinds.twin_record: directory backing a catalogue twin record (catalog/twins/*.json) whose geometry is an F0 or F1 proxy of one part or zone
kinds.part_evidence: evidence store for a catalogue part record that has no twin record
kinds.design_programme: design or redesign of a part on assumed or unadmitted geometry, with numerical screens
kinds.numerical_study: bounded calculation or comparison on assumed geometry; results are model outputs
kinds.packaging_study: parametric layout of several bodies in a local frame; no measured fit
kinds.system_programme: register of zones, functions, interfaces or load cases across several components
kinds.research_register: documentary input matrix and research ledger; no geometry admitted
kinds.usd_scene: OpenUSD composition or documentary proxies; a valid stage asserts no fit
kinds.simready_fixture: external SimReady reference assets used to exercise the OpenUSD pipeline; no Porsche part
kinds.software_witness: compute, station or session manifest proving software execution only
kinds.reference_envelope: parametric bounding cage from published dimensions; not a body or part
kinds.archived_reference: retired as a product and kept as a numerical regression (docs/ARCHIVE.md)
kinds.physical_twin: reserved: allowed only when a linked twin record has validation.status physically_correlated; no directory qualifies today

statuses.active: at least one open issue in the backlog targets the directory
statuses.study: retained and checked; no open issue targets it
statuses.archived: declared archived by its README, its record or docs/ARCHIVE.md

fidelity_rule: fidelity is copied from the linked twin record; a directory without a twin record has fidelity none_declared, whatever its directory suffix. Suffixes such as -f0, -f1 or F15 are iteration labels, not levels of the fidelity ladder.

directories.scope: Top-down CAD twin of the Wolfe Classics 935 Xtreme head scan: fitted datums, bare-head occupancy, reference surface, section-loft CAD body as one closed solid, scorecards, thermal screens, OpenUSD stages, 3MF studies, AM screen, port-flow audit, fitted machined features (valve axes, guides, seats, plug bores, stud passages) a .usda/.usdz package with a collider, two alloy thermal screens (bare head and hypothesis assembly) with a machine survey, a print body with declared machining stock, and a deposition witness for the build simulation
directories.no_record_reason: Study reconstruction of a scanned specimen; unobserved geometry is declared hypothesis and no part is proposed.
directories.independent_evidence: independent Warp scan-to-twin scorecard against the acquired surface only, reproduced by CloudCompare; CloudCompare on held-out scan vertices confirms 4 of 32 fitted features within 0.2 mm; no physical measurement
blockers: no physical calibration or same-specimen measurement
unobserved fin roots, passages and port interiors are hypotheses (hypotheses.json)
no B-rep of the whole body: the CAD body is a triangle solid that keeps stubs up to 5.5 mm tall of three removed studs
valves, seats and guides are fitted as nominal numbers only and not modelled, so no port-flow domain is admissible
